title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

faults.what: The left panel is not the supplied original photo: its clutter and right-hand sink have been removed, and its framing and perspective have changed.
The renovated panel removes both original sink-and-faucet locations, replacing them with uninterrupted countertops, contrary to preserving major fixtures.
The renovated kitchen retains a general U-shaped arrangement but changes the cabinet proportions and camera viewpoint rather than matching the original room.
The renovated counters look uniformly beige, without clearly visible light-oak grain.
The finished image is slightly wider than the requested 16:9 aspect ratio.

judge.summary: The image has clear labels and a clean white makeover, but it alters the before photo and removes essential fixtures instead of faithfully renovating the supplied kitchen.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
must_haves.why: There is one side-by-side image, but the left is an altered reconstruction rather than the supplied original, and the overall aspect ratio is slightly wider than 16:9.

must_haves.item: The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
must_haves.why: Brown cabinets and beige tiles remain, but the original clutter has been removed.

must_haves.item: The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
must_haves.why: White shaker cabinets, white rectangular tiles and uncluttered counters are visible, but the counters read as plain beige rather than clearly light oak.

must_haves.item: The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
must_haves.why: The broad U-shaped layout remains, but both sink locations disappear and the viewpoint and cabinetry proportions change.

must_haves.item: Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.
must_haves.why: Both labels are correctly spelled, readable and positioned above their respective panels.
